title: Total Variation Guarantees for Sampling with Stochastic Localization
summary: Motivated by the success of score-based generative models, a number of diffusion-based algorithms have recently been proposed for the problem of sampling from a probability measure whose unnormalized density can be accessed. Among them, Grenioux et al. introduced SLIPS, a sampling algorithm based on Stochastic Localization. While SLIPS exhibits strong empirical performance, no rigorous convergence analysis has previously been provided.
